div.head: V Atr 33.1
div.ab: Forþam þurh þæt hit sceal on earde godian to ahte, þe man unriht alecge ⁊ rihtwisnesse lufie for Gode ⁊ for worolde.
Forþam þurh þæt hit sceal on earde godian to ahte, þe man unriht alecge ⁊ rihtwisnesse lufige for Gode ⁊ for worolde. Amen.
Forðam þurh þæt hit sceal on earde godian to ahte, þæt man unriht alecge ⁊ rihtwisnesse lufige for Gode ⁊ for worlde.
Forðam þurh þæt hit sceal on earde godian to ahte, þæt man unriht alecge ⁊ rihtwisnesse lufige for Gode ⁊ for worlde.
Forþam þurh þæt hit sceal on earde godian to ahte, þe man unriht alecge and rihtwisnesse lufie for Gode and for worolde.
Denn um etwas [Bedeutendes] besser werden im Lande wird es dadurch, dass man Unrecht beseitige und Gerechtigkeit achte im Geistlichen und Weltlichen. (Amen. G2.)
For things will become considerably better in the land through putting down injustice and loving righteousness in matters spiritual and secular. (Amen. G2)
For it is only by the suppression of injustice and the love of righteousness, in matters both religious and secular, that any improvement shall be obtained in the condition of our country.
For [only] as a result of suppressing wrong and loving righteousness will there be improvement at all in the country in religious and secular concerns.
Because it is by purging injustice and embracing righteousness before God and the world that improvement shall be brought to the land.
